hook: I got scammed online and **money left my account.**
hook_q: How do I report a cyber fraud?

slides.title: Call **1930** or go online.
slides.body: 1930 is the government's toll-free helpline for help lodging online cyber complaints. You can also report any type of cyber crime on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal: **cybercrime.gov.in**.

slides.title: Lost money? Report **immediately.**
slides.body: The government's Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting and Management System was set up for immediate reporting of financial frauds and to stop fraudsters siphoning off the money.

slides.title: Tell **your bank** at the earliest.
slides.body: Report the unauthorised electronic transaction to your bank as soon as possible. Under RBI rules, loss after you report it is borne by the bank, even if you had shared your payment details.
slides.ref: RBI Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct Directions 2025 · Para 66, 68(1)

slides.title: Bank at fault? **Zero liability.**
slides.body: If the fraud happened because of the bank's negligence or deficiency, you have zero liability, whether or not you reported it. And it is the bank that must prove any liability is yours.
slides.ref: RBI Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct Directions 2025 · Para 67(1), 75

slides.title: Only a suspicious call or SMS? Use **Chakshu.**
list: Suspected fraud call, SMS or WhatsApp? Report on Chakshu
Chakshu is not for money already lost

sources: MHA / I4C: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, Helpline 1930, CFCFRMS (PIB, 11 Feb 2026)
RBI (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025 – Chapter IV Section D, Paras 66, 67, 68, 75 (rbi.org.in)
caption:
Lost money to an online scam? Here's how to report it. 👇

1️⃣ Call the toll-free helpline 1930 or report on cybercrime.gov.in
2️⃣ Report financial fraud immediately: the system exists to stop fraudsters siphoning off funds
3️⃣ Tell your bank at the earliest. Under RBI rules, loss after you report is borne by the bank
4️⃣ Bank's negligence or deficiency? Zero liability, and the bank must prove any liability is yours
5️⃣ Only got a suspicious call, SMS or WhatsApp? Report it on Chakshu (sancharsaathi.gov.in). For money lost, use 1930

Source: MHA / I4C (PIB); RBI (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025, Section D; DoT Sanchar Saathi
